{{Quote|The agreement was that the funds would be transmitted ''only'' when the job was completed!|The dive owner, to a disguised Jyl Somtay|<ref name="Jedi Masquerade" />}}
A '''dive owner''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who operated in a [[Unidentified Coruscant dive|dive]] located in the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underlevels]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he worked as a middleman and hired [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] to [[Assassination attempt on Yong Dolor|assassinate]] [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Yong Dolor]]. However, the assassination attempt was foiled by the intervention of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jyl Somtay]]. Following this event, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] got a lead on the dive owner as he had previously been arrested for selling the [[Poison/Legends|poison]] that was found on Sing's [[Ryyk blade/Legends|ryyk blade]]. Disguised as Sing, Somtay convinced the dive owner to meet with his client in his [[Lorn's office|office]]. Yong Dolor's assistant, [[Lorn (aide)|Lorn]], was then exposed as the instigator of the assassination attempt. Revealing her true identity, Somtay arrested both Lorn and the dive owner.
